title: PSA - Effigy V0.5.0 release
author: CmdrCallandra
selftext:
Effigy is a free, MIT-licensed tool that turns a picture or a sentence into game-ready 3D assets, textures and 2D sprites on your own GPU: generate, clean, retopo, texture, rig, animate and export, fully offline on one 16 GB NVIDIA card. Every model in it allows commercial use of what you make.



What's new in 0.5.0 (since 0.4.0):



• RTX 30 series support: the bundled GPU kernels are now built for RTX 30, 40 and 50. A user's RTX 3080 Laptop (16 GB) ran the Fast chain, texture detail and the standing pose. The Faithful chain isn't measured on RTX 30 yet.



• Library folders: browse your assets like a file browser, with nested folders, move/remove, and search across all of them. You can also keep several libraries on different drives and switch between them.



• Batch import: point it at a folder or a manifest and bring in many models at once. A check lists what will happen first, the import can be cancelled, and re-importing skips what's already there. Tested with about 2,800 models.



• Your own animation packs: drop a folder of animation GLBs with a pack.json next to the ready-made clips and it shows up with its own move sets.



• Animation tools: duplicate a clip mirrored (a left-handed swing from a right-handed one), Butterworth smoothing beside the Gaussian, and hips that follow a locked foot so the knee never snaps straight.

  
• Better fingers: skeleton fitting now renders each hand close up from eight sides and reads the finger joints with MediaPipe, instead of guessing from one full-body picture.



• New workspace layout: a tool strip per step replaces the Tools menu and folded panels. Every tool can be opened, and one that doesn't fit the current version tells you what it needs.



• Blender everywhere: Open in Blender / Save back on every asset page, and it now works with Blender's own free MCP add-on.



• Licence tracking for imports: imported assets and clip packs without a clean licence are marked restricted until you state the licence, so nothing unclear ends up in an export.



• For agents: new MCP tools to organise the library and run batch imports.



Runs on Windows 11 with an NVIDIA 16 GB card (AMD RX 9070 on the Fast engine).



Download and install notes: [https://github.com/SifuInTheShell/Effigy/releases](https://github.com/SifuInTheShell/Effigy/releases)



Full changelog: [https://github.com/SifuInTheShell/Effigy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SifuInTheShell/Effigy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
